# Cambridge Dictionary

> > Cambridge Dictionary provides comprehensive English-French translations with authentic examples from the Cambridge English Corpus, Europarl Parallel Corpus, and Hansard archive.

The dictionary is published by Cambridge University Press and K Dictionaries Ltd, offering bilingual translation services with real-world usage examples from parliamentary debates, academic sources, and multilingual corpora. The site features word definitions, phrasal verbs, idiomatic expressions, and announces an annual Word of the Year.

## Key Topics

- English-French translation
- Bilingual dictionary

- Cambridge University Press
- Multilingual dictionary

- [ACCOMPANY in French](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english-french/accompany): English-French translation for verb 'accompany' with usage examples
